name: Ariden's Camp
summary: Ariden's Camp is an abandoned encampment nestled just north of the path threading through Deadwind Pass. Left decaying in the shadow of Karazhan, it stands as an eerie, quiet anomaly amidst the desolate canyon winds. Travelers between Duskwood and the Swamp of Sorrows often pass it with unease, unaware of the cursed peddler who once pitched his tent here.

sections.title: A Silent Encampment
sections.body: Tucked against the crags north of the gorge road connecting Duskwood to the Swamp of Sorrows, this dilapidated campsite looks like an ordinary transient stop long forsaken by living men. Yet in the oppressive gloom of Deadwind Pass, nothing remains unmarred by dark sorcery. The camp belonged to a peddler named Ariden, who brazenly attempted to hawk forged magical trinkets and curios claimed to have come from the tower of Medivh. Whatever fortune he sought in Karazhan's orbit was swallowed by the pass's lingering horrors, leaving only weathered cloth, cold ashes, and an enduring mystery.

sections.title: The Peddler's Folly
sections.body: Ariden was not merely an unlucky vagrant, but a grifter whose deceit unraveled terribly in the vicinity of the Guardian's seat. His hubris in profiting from Karazhan's sinister name drew a grim fate down upon him and his cohort, binding him to the very valley he sought to exploit as the leader of the spectral Dark Riders. The decaying remnants of his shelter stand undisturbed, a mundane tombstone marking where mortal avarice collided with forces far beyond mortal reckoning.

faq.answer: Ariden's Camp is located in Deadwind Pass, situated just north of the main road that links Duskwood in the west to the Swamp of Sorrows in the east, not far from Karazhan.

Ariden was an unscrupulous merchant and peddler who established this camp to sell fake artifacts attributed to Medivh, the Last Guardian. His reckless greed ultimately doomed him to a dreadful curse, binding him as the leader of the terrifying Dark Riders of Karazhan.

The camp was abandoned after Ariden and his associates fell victim to the dark, supernatural energies surrounding Deadwind Pass. Instead of walking the camp as living men, they were transformed into wandering, cursed spirits compelled to hunt real relics.

faq.q: Are there any active threats at the camp right now?
faq.answer: The immediate clearing of the camp is quiet and eerily still, though Deadwind Pass itself is prowled by deadly deadwind ogres, spectral apparitions, and the foul winged beasts that roost near Karazhan.

angles.text: For scholars of the arcane, the ruined camp is an unsettling reminder of the hubris surrounding Karazhan; meddling with the legacy of Medivh rarely leaves charlatans unscathed.
A con artist setting up shop to peddle counterfeit relics beneath the most terrifying spire in the Eastern Kingdoms is either extraordinarily ambitious or remarkably foolish.
